biotools.summary: Doscheda focuses on quantitative chemoproteomics used to determine protein interaction profiles of small molecules from whole cell or tissue lysates using Mass Spectrometry data. The package provides a shiny application to run the pipeline, several visualisations and a downloadable report of an experiment.
